text_to_image_prompt: Photographic six-angle head reference sheet of a seventeen-year-old boy with tight tousled copper-red curls, pale green-gray eyes, many warm freckles, youthful soft jaw, no beard, light gray hoodie and black utility vest with black headphones around his neck.  Exactly six equal head-and-shoulder panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid, same person and hairstyle in every panel. Top row: direct centered FRONT, left three-quarter 45 degrees, right three-quarter 45 degrees. Bottom row: true LEFT profile 90 degrees, true RIGHT profile 90 degrees, BACK of head 180 degrees. Eye-level camera in ALL panels, upright head, neutral closed lips, level eye line, anatomically balanced face, no head tilt, preserve skull and jaw. Full hair visible with whitespace. Identical cream-white seamless background and bright soft frontal daylight, realistic skin pores and textile texture, low contrast. No text, no labels, no duplicated angles.

original_prompt: Create the specified six-angle reference sheet using the attached image as strict identity and costume reference. Keep the same person, age, face shape, eye color, hairstyle and photographic rendering; do not invent a different face. Photographic six-angle head reference sheet of a seventeen-year-old boy with tight tousled copper-red curls, pale green-gray eyes, many warm freckles, youthful soft jaw, no beard, light gray hoodie and black utility vest with black headphones around his neck.  Exactly six equal head-and-shoulder panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid, same person and hairstyle in every panel. Top row: direct centered FRONT, left three-quarter 45 degrees, right three-quarter 45 degrees. Bottom row: true LEFT profile 90 degrees, true RIGHT profile 90 degrees, BACK of head 180 degrees. Eye-level camera in ALL panels, upright head, neutral closed lips, level eye line, anatomically balanced face, no head tilt, preserve skull and jaw. Full hair visible with whitespace.
